name: Michael Lizzio
headline: Software Engineering Major at RIT
bio: Aspiring software engineer with strong communication skills and a passion for sharing knowledge and collaborating on complex and challenging problems. I work mostly in Python, with a foundational understanding of several other languages, and I'm eager to expand my knowledge and keep learning new skills.
about: I'm a passionate computer programmer. When I got a Raspberry Pi for Christmas of 2018, I was super excited. Looking back on it, I am grateful that I had the unique opportunity to learn computer programming by just messing around and exploring the environment while making silly and sometimes complex projects.

As my knowledge of computer science has grown over the years I have gradually realized how crucial syntax, code structure, and careful planning gives you the ability to create anything you can imagine.
What I find exciting about computer science is that there's always something new to learn. I'm looking forward to picking up more programming skills to improve my abilities.
